Microsoft's consumer commerce platforms power high-scale transactions, subscriptions, digital ownership, and partner ecosystems across Xbox and other Microsoft businesses. Customers and partners must be able to trust that these capabilities are safe, compliant, resilient, transparent, and protected from fraud and abuse in every market where Microsoft operates.
As the Principal Product Manager - Commerce Trust , you will own the integrated product strategy for consumer commerce. You will bring together regulatory and financial controls, compliance-by-design, fraud and abuse prevention, risk signals and decisioning, customer and partner protections, auditability, and coordinated operational response into one durable portfolio.
This is a product leadership role requiring deep commerce, risk, and technical judgment. You will lead through influence across Commerce, Xbox, engineering, data science, identity, security, safety, finance, legal and policy, privacy, audit, support, and Microsoft's central risk capabilities. Success requires reducing financial and reputational exposure while protecting legitimate-customer conversion, publisher confidence, and business growth.
At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress—people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.
Responsibilities
Define the multi-year Commerce Trust, Fraud and Abuse strategy, investment thesis, roadmap, operating model, and measurable customer, partner, business, and risk outcomes.
Create a unified portfolio spanning regulatory requirements, consumer protection, financial-crime programs, privacy and policy obligations, SOX and audit controls, fraud prevention, abuse prevention, and trust-related launch readiness.
Establish a common threat and control taxonomy across account abuse, payment fraud, refund abuse, market arbitrage, stored value and gift cards, bots, entitlements, promotions, identity risk, and emerging attack patterns.
Lead product requirements for reusable controls, trust primitives, shared risk signals, data products, detection, decisioning, customer challenges, enforcement, recovery, evidence, monitoring, and remediation.
Prioritize investments using financial exposure, customer and publisher impact, regulatory urgency, attack velocity, operational cost, control effectiveness, and confidence in the available intervention.
Define customer and partner experiences for disclosures, eligibility and trust checks, consent, exceptions, appeals, remediation, and support while actively managing false positives and unnecessary friction.
Create common playbooks for live-site response, investigations, regulatory or audit inquiries, escalation, decision rights, communications, evidence preservation, and post-incident learning.
Partner with engineering to build reusable trust and risk capabilities that can be adopted across Xbox and non-Xbox businesses without duplicating market- or business-specific implementations.
Build durable partnerships with data science, identity, security, gaming safety, finance, legal and policy, privacy, audit, customer support, and Microsoft's central fraud and risk organizations.
Represent the portfolio in executive reviews, translate complex exposure into product and investment choices, close accountability gaps, and mentor Product Managers and cross-functional leaders.

Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development OR equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications

OpenAI’s Compute Strategy & Partnerships team develops the partnerships and transactions that support our long-term ambitions. Our work across industrial compute spans cloud infrastructure, semiconductors, datacenters, energy, and financing—bringing together the technology, capital, and commercial relationships needed to build and deploy AI at scale.

We’re looking for a Business Development professional to help originate, structure, negotiate, and execute complex strategic partnerships. You’ll work at the intersection of business strategy, finance, technology, and law, turning ambitious objectives into executable agreements and durable relationships.

This role offers direct commercial responsibility across the transaction lifecycle: identifying opportunities, developing a business case, shaping deal terms, aligning internal stakeholders, negotiating with counterparties, and supporting implementation. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in business development, transactional law, finance, or investing. An experienced attorney interested in applying their deal skills to commercial strategy and execution could be an excellent fit.

 - Meaningful experience structuring and negotiating complex transactions. Relevant backgrounds include M&A, structured finance, project finance, restructuring, commercial real estate, and strategic commercial agreements.

 - Strong commercial and financial judgment, including the ability to connect contractual provisions to economics, incentives, and practical business outcomes.

 - A record of taking ownership of demanding workstreams and advancing transactions involving multiple parties and competing priorities.

 - Excellent writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly to executives, technical colleagues, and external partners.

About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. Achieving this goal requires not only building cutting-edge technology, but ensuring it is deployed responsibly in real-world contexts. OpenAI for Government partners with U.S. and allied government institutions to support the responsible adoption of AI across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. We work at the intersection of technology, policy, and operations to ensure that our tools are deployed in ways that are effective, aligned with democratic values, and grounded in real-world consequences.

As part of the OpenAI for Government team you will work across federal, state, and local governments, helping to accelerate adoption through hands-on support, tailored training, and early insights—so civil servants can spend less time on red tape and more on meaningful work. If you're passionate about responsibly deploying frontier AI to uplift public institutions and transform how the government works, we want you on our team.

Our Executive Business Partners serve as trusted advisors and collaborators to OpenAI's executives and leaders, focused on strong communication and operational excellence across teams. With a focus on elevating the impact and efficiency of leadership, we anticipate needs, streamline processes, and provide comprehensive support to ensure our executives can focus on high-impact initiatives. We play a pivotal role in driving success and achieving key milestones by cultivating strong relationships and leveraging our deep understanding of business objectives. With a commitment to excellence and a proactive approach, we are dedicated to empowering our executives and contributing to the overall growth and success of the company.

Our leadership team reflects OpenAI’s culture and core values and is a mission-driven, kind, and thoughtful group. We take pride in creating a work environment that fosters collaboration, open communication, and authenticity, making OpenAI an excellent place to work for highly accomplished professionals.

The Executive Business Partner will be a proactive and adaptable partner to executives, managing complex scheduling, coordinating projects, and optimizing workflows. This role requires independence, task-level ownership, and a deep understanding of OpenAI’s mission to foster AGI that benefits humanity. The ideal candidate can handle structured tasks with minimal oversight, while actively learning and applying best practices to support evolving business needs.

In this role, you will:

 - Build strong connections within the immediate team and across other departments, becoming a trusted partner to leaders. This includes an understanding of team dynamics, priorities, and stakeholders, facilitating seamless coordination on high-stakes projects.

 - Expertly manage the calendars, scheduling, and logistics of leaders across classified and unclassified engagements—including interagency meetings, secure briefings, site visits, and high-priority external meetings—while anticipating needs, adapting quickly to shifting priorities, and ensuring leaders are well-prepared and operating efficiently.

 - Serve as an execution lead for major OpenAI for Government events, government workshops, sponsorships, training, and customer meetings,  Work seamlessly with key stakeholders in OpenAI’s Washington, DC office to ensure a high quality experience for strategic on-site visits. 

 - Establish systems to track and log interactions with key external partners, keeping leaders informed and prepared for meetings.

 You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 4-7 years of experience in an executive support role or similar support function.

 - 2-3 years of experience managing complex scheduling, logistics, and high-level meetings with senior government, defense, and international leaders, including coordinating clearances, handling sensitive information, and navigating agency systems and protocols.

 - Proven experience working with multiple leaders in the past.

 - Worked in a high-growth startup, or similar environment.

 - Managed and optimized extremely busy calendars.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for quality, with the ability to anticipate issues, catch small errors before they become larger problems, and ensure every deliverable, meeting, and interaction is executed to a polished standard.

 - Flawless execution skills for events and meetings of all sizes.

 - Exceptional communication skills - being able to tailor a message appropriate to a specific audience (writing an email to a Senator vs. a Customer vs. an Exec)

 - Ability to motivate and align teams, driving accountability and helping leaders and cross-functional partners stay focused on shared priorities.

 - Proven ability to build processes and operational systems from the ground up, bringing structure to ambiguity and creating scalable ways of working in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

 - Professionalism and Discretion - You understand the balance between transparency and confidentiality.

 - Be an independent task level operator: own work from planning through follow-up, anticipate needs, and use sound judgment about when to act independently and when to escalate.

 - Very fluent in Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, etc. and other modern productivity software, and are excited to learn and use new tools.

title: Integrations Architect - Enterprise Systems
description:
About the Team

The Supply Chain Technology team within OpenAI's Enterprise Platform & Technology organization builds the systems and data foundations that support our supply chain and partner operations. We connect enterprise applications, improve operational visibility, and automate workflows across planning, purchasing, manufacturing, inventory, fulfillment, and returns. We work closely with engineering and business teams to build reliable systems that can evolve with OpenAI's growth.

About the Role

We are seeking an Integrations Architect to set technical direction for enterprise integrations, with a strong focus on supply chain and external partner ecosystems. You will help evolve a growing integration portfolio into a scalable, maintainable foundation through clear architecture, reusable patterns, and strong engineering practices. You will also help establish shared integration architecture and reusable foundations needed to support Finance and Supply Chain systems.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will translate business processes into integration designs, evaluate existing implementations, challenge assumptions, and guide improvements from design through production. Your influence will extend across application engineers, integration engineers, platform teams, and business stakeholders.

You will own integration architecture and partner with the engineering team responsible for the shared integration platform. Through clear requirements, working implementations, and operational evidence, you will help shape capabilities that improve how integrations are developed, tested, deployed, observed, and recovered.

In this role, you will:

 - Own integration architecture across enterprise applications, custom services, and external partners, including e-commerce platforms, logistics providers, contract manufacturers, retailers, and distributors.

 - Translate supply chain processes into clear system boundaries, transaction flows, data ownership, interface contracts, and operational requirements.

 - Partner with Finance and engineering teams to establish reusable integration patterns connecting operational and financial systems, with clear data ownership, reconciliation, and auditability.

 - Assess existing integrations and lead a practical modernization roadmap that improves scalability, reliability, maintainability, and cost while sustaining business delivery.

 - Establish reference architectures, reusable connectors, API and event standards, data mappings, versioning practices, and documented design decisions. Lead design and code reviews and mentor engineers.

 - Select appropriate API, messaging, EDI, orchestration, and batch patterns, balancing platform capabilities with custom development and the needs of each business process.

 - Stay close to implementation by building Python services and reference solutions, reviewing code, resolving difficult production issues, and validating designs through tests and measurable behavior.

 - Define reliability and recovery patterns, including idempotency, retries, reconciliation, replay, and continuity planning. Establish operational objectives and ownership across system boundaries.

 - Enable observability that follows business transactions across systems, connecting technical execution to business outcomes and supporting diagnosis, safe recovery, and ongoing improvement.

 - Turn integration delivery experience into prioritized platform requirements and influence shared engineering roadmaps through prototypes, acceptance criteria, and evidence of value.

 - Enable effective AI-assisted development and agentic workflows through well-defined interfaces, testable behavior, explicit approvals, and controls over execution and cost. Apply MCP tools, plugins, or comparable approaches where useful.

 - Embed security, access controls, segregation of duties, auditability, and change management into integration design. Coordinate partner testing, cutover, and operational readiness.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring 10+ years of experience in enterprise integration engineering and architecture, including technical leadership for business-critical systems.

 - Understand supply chain processes well enough to independently translate purchasing, receiving, order management, fulfillment, and inventory needs into integrations and explain the operational impact of missing or incorrect transactions.

 - Can support integrations across Supply Chain & Finance systems, working with subject matter experts to translate business processes, reconciliation needs, and financial controls into reliable designs.

 - Have personally shaped architectures, improved existing implementations, and guided engineers toward reusable, maintainable solutions with measurable results.

 - Have deep experience across multiple integration platforms and approaches, including iPaaS and custom services, and can translate their strengths and limitations into useful platform requirements.

 - Are a strong Python engineer who can connect design recommendations to production code, automated tests, deployment practices, and troubleshooting.

 - Understand API and event design, asynchronous messaging, EDI, data contracts, authentication, transaction integrity, and failure recovery across distributed systems.

 - Have built and operated high-volume integrations and can reason about performance, capacity, reliability, observability, and operating cost.

 - Are comfortable with cloud infrastructure, containerized services, version control, CI/CD, and automated integration testing.

 - Can influence technical direction across teams, explain tradeoffs to business stakeholders, and mentor engineers without relying on reporting authority.

 - Work independently, navigate ambiguity, and take responsibility for outcomes from initial design through sustained operation.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Integrations with Oracle Fusion ERP or SCM and adjacent enterprise applications such as warehouse, transportation, planning, or product lifecycle management systems.

 - Shaping shared integration platforms, developer tooling, or self-service capabilities adopted by multiple teams.

 - Building MCP servers, plugins, or agentic enterprise workflows, and applying AI coding tools such as Codex with rigorous review and validation.

Location

San Francisco Office. Hybrid schedule of 3 days per week onsite.

We’re looking for an Organizational Design Lead to help build our organizational design capability and shape how people and AI agents work together.

You’ll partner with leaders and People colleagues to understand business goals, examine how work gets done, and design the roles, structures, decision processes, and workflows that help teams succeed. Critical Harm Operations sits within User Safety & Risk Operations and builds enforcement systems for Frontier Risk and Material Harm that are accurate, fast, defensible, and built to scale. We turn policy intent into operational readiness, review standards, quality systems, escalation paths, automation guardrails, and durable cross-functional operating models.

We are looking for an exceptional Program Manager to help build durable operating systems and run some of OpenAI’s most complex safety operations. The core need is a high-agency operator who can take an ambiguous problem, create the right structure, align cross-functional partners, and drive the work through execution.

This role will move across Critical Harm priorities as needs evolve. You may step into operationalizing national security or violent-activities workflows, support wellbeing and Frontier Risk initiatives, or help scale programs such as Trusted Access. Deep domain expertise is helpful but not required; the strongest candidates will learn quickly, exercise excellent judgment, and make complex programs move.

 - Lead strategic operational builds across priority workflows from problem statement to implemented operating model, including scope, owners, milestones, risks, success measures, and execution cadence.

About the Team

At OpenAI, we are building the connective tissue between our mission and our people. People Innovation Labs is a fast-moving engineering team embedded in the People organization, focused on rethinking how we find and retain the best talent and empower everyone to do their best work.

We are not a typical internal tools team. From recruiting to culture, we design and build systems that give the People Team a significant edge by infusing OpenAI’s models and first-principles thinking into how we operate. Our work spans greenfield 0→1 products like OpenHouse (our internal knowledge hub), AI-powered automations, performance and growth systems, and scalable recruiting infrastructure. We operate in a highly cross-functional environment, partnering closely with HR, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and executive stakeholders.



About the Role

We’re looking for a Program Manager to own execution, coordination, and delivery across People Innovation Labs’ most complex and cross-cutting initiatives. This role is distinct from the Product Manager role and is focused on how work gets done rather than what we build.

As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for translating product strategy into executable plans, managing dependencies across teams and systems, and ensuring that high-stakes initiatives land predictably and cleanly in a fast-growing, high-context environment. You will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Design, and People stakeholders to drive clarity, accountability, and momentum across the portfolio.

Because we build new products from the ground up, the work does not end when a product launches. You’ll own ongoing engagement with users, including onboarding, training, hands-on support, and creating clear ways for people to share feedback. You’ll develop a deep understanding of how our products fit into users’ day-to-day work, what is working, and where they are struggling. You’ll bring those insights back to product, design, and engineering so the team can iterate quickly toward product-market fit.

You’ll also help keep the team aligned with its broader objectives. You’ll maintain a clear view of priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes across the portfolio and provide clear updates and recommendations to team and company leadership.

This role is ideal for someone who excels at orchestrating work across many teams, navigating ambiguity and organizational complexity, and creating the operating structure that allows product and engineering teams to move quickly without chaos.



In this role, you will:

 - Own program execution across multiple People Innovation Labs initiatives, ensuring clear plans, milestones, owners, and timelines

 - Drive cross-functional alignment across People, Recruiting, HRBPs, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and Engineering partners

 - Manage dependencies and sequencing across systems (e.g., HRIS, ATS, permissions, data pipelines, rollout infrastructure)

 - Identify risks, bottlenecks, and tradeoffs early, and proactively surface and resolve them

 - Establish and maintain operating cadence for key initiatives, including status updates, reviews, launch readiness, and retrospectives

 - Create clear, actionable documentation such as program plans, decision logs, rollout plans, and exec updates

 - Support product launches by coordinating readiness across training, comms, support, data, and operational workflows

 - Own communication, enablement, change management, and rollout strategies for new products and workflows.

 - Lead post-launch user engagement through onboarding, training, office hours, hands-on support, and other programs that drive adoption.

 - Build trusted relationships with users and create an environment where they provide frequent, candid feedback.

 - Observe how products fit into real workflows and identify points of confusion, friction, or unmet need.

 - Combine user feedback, usage data, and operational signals to understand what is working and what needs to change.

 - Track delivery health and operational success metrics (e.g., timelines, adoption readiness, launch quality, post-launch issues)

 - Have 7+ years of experience as a Program Manager, Technical Program Manager, or in a similar execution-focused role

 - Are exceptionally strong at turning ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work into clear plans and accountable execution

 - Communicate crisply and confidently across a wide range of audiences, including senior leaders

 - Enjoy operating at the intersection of product, engineering, and business operations

 - Are comfortable managing complexity across multiple systems, teams, and timelines

 - Know how to introduce structure and rigor without creating unnecessary process or slowing teams down

 - Have experience supporting launches of operationally intensive products or platforms

The Hardware Marketing team helps people understand what OpenAI’s hardware products can do and how they can fit into everyday life. We work with Product Marketing, Design, Creative, Sales, and Operations to bring products to market and create experiences where people can try them for themselves.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Visual Merchant to shape how customers discover, understand, and try OpenAI hardware in stores. Reporting to the Channel Lead, you’ll own visual merchandising for OpenAI-owned experiences and third-party retail. You’ll work with Creative, Design, and retail partners to build displays that tell a clear product story and make it easy for customers to get hands-on.

You’ll take the work from concept through installation, setting a standard in our own spaces and adapting it for partner stores. You’ll be as comfortable giving feedback on a prototype as you are walking a store to see what customers notice, touch, and miss.

In this role, you will:

 - Make the product story visible. Set the order in which customers see products, signage, and demos. Work with Product Marketing and Creative to keep claims accurate and give customers a clear place to start.

 - Develop visual merchandising for OpenAI experiences. Work with Design, Creative, and production partners on fixture placement, displays, signage, and hands-on demo stations. Use mockups and site visits to check sightlines, accessibility, and flow.

 - Develop the experience for global retail partners. Define what needs to stay consistent across stores and what can change for different footprints, retailer standards, and local markets. Review partner concepts, samples, and layouts before rollout.

 - Turn standards into tools store teams can use. Create layout guides, fixture and signage specifications, and setup and reset instructions. Partner with Production and Retail Operations on prototypes, installation, and quality checks so displays are safe and can be maintained day to day.

 - Use what you see in stores to improve the work. Watch how customers approach and use displays, gather feedback from store teams, and check whether installations match the brief. Use what you learn to fix issues and update the next rollout.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - Built visual merchandising for physical retail and can show how you took work from concept through installation. Experience with both brand-owned and partner stores is a plus.

 - Made a complex product easy to discover and try through strong spatial layout, signage, and demo presentation. Experience with consumer technology or hands-on product demos is a plus.

 - Translated creative direction into practical layouts, specifications, and guides that store teams and vendors can use.

 - Worked with Creative, Design, Production, Operations, and retail partners to solve on-site issues and maintain a consistent standard across locations.

 - Used store observations or customer feedback to improve what people notice and understand, and know how to keep displays accessible and maintainable.

title: Principal Digital Sculptor - Fixed Term
description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.
Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.
We’re looking for a talented and passionate Principal Digital Sculptor (Fixed Term) to join our forward-thinking team. In this role, you’ll play a key part in bringing next-generation hardware designs to life—bridging the gap between visionary industrial design and production-ready reality through world-class 3D modeling and visualization, and influencing the technical direction of the team.
What you will do:
Partner closely with industrial design, engineering, and manufacturing teams to translate design intent into precise, high-quality 3D CAD models.
Apply advanced surfacing techniques to sculpt complex forms that maintain aesthetic excellence and support manufacturability.
Develop high-fidelity visualizations and photorealistic renderings that clearly communicate product concepts and features.
Leverage your deep understanding of design principles and production methods to ensure models are optimized for prototyping and manufacturing.
Iterate quickly and thoughtfully based on feedback, with a keen eye for precision and detail.
Contribute to the evolution of our design language through craftsmanship, creativity, and technical mastery.
Contribute to the development and implementation of new tools, workflows, and technologies to enhance modeling and visualization efficiency and quality.
This is a hybrid-remote role, with the expectation to work from our San Francisco offices at least half-time.
REQUIREMENTS
We would love consider you for our role if you have:
10 yrs + experience in advanced 3D CAD tools, including Autodesk Alias and Siemens NX.
Expert level experience with Keyshot or similar rendering/visualization tools.
Strong familiarity with Substance or other material/texture creation software is a strong plus.
A solid foundation in industrial design principles and product development workflows, with an ability to anticipate and solve complex design challenges.
In-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes and their impact on 3D modeling and surface development, and the ability to proactively optimize designs for production.
Exceptional skill in creating highly detailed, accurate, and production-ready 3D models.
A comprehensive portfolio that showcases your mastery in 3D modeling, surfacing, and visualization for product design, demonstrating significant contributions to shipped products.
Strong experience preparing 3D models for rapid prototyping or tooling.
Strong communication and collaboration skills—able to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
A passion for cutting-edge technology and designing products that make a difference in people’s lives.
BENEFITS
At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health and add to our benefits!
What we offer:
Competitive salary and equity packages
Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
Paid sick leave and parental leave
Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers

Role Summary This role is with the Special Projects Team based in Irvine, CA. Our department is responsible for component, system and full-vehicle prototypes and marketing/show vehicle builds at Rivian. This includes the ability to take almost anything from a sketch or rough concept and turn it into a physical product as quickly as possible. Our group features engineers, program managers, fabricators, technicians, and others focused on efficient design and high-quality, short-duration builds. We support production development and manufacturing through our prototype development but are not release responsible for production parts. We also support an assortment of non-production related vehicle activities such as Ben & Jerry’s Ice Cream Van, Grey’s Anatomy TV Show Ambulance, Also Mobile Service Van, and various first responder vehicles. Our engineers need to understand production intent design and manufacturing processes but also the design requirements and limitations of quick build fabrication and one-off prototype processes. This can often mean simplifying a design so it can be bent, welded and created by hand or from a simple tool or fixture. It also means working very closely with the fabrication part of our team to understand what is possible and adapting the design to something built from off-the-shelf parts and supplies. You will work on parts across every vehicle system and could start with a blank page or a complete production design. In all cases, it will be your responsibility to make sure we deliver amazing prototypes. We focus on building fast, learning lessons, quickly iterating on the design and making updates. Our projects range from several hours where we will have a request in the morning and a physical part to test by the end of the day to mules that take months to complete. You will get to experience a variety of projects, will be expected to showcase our capability to the rest of the company and will work hard to make cool things happen. A collaborative attitude and ability to work tirelessly on a design only to toss it out and start over as requirements change is key. This role is in Irvine, CA and will require some travel to our other office locations including Plymouth, MI and Normal, IL. Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:
We are looking for a strategic, results-oriented leader to drive Samsara’s NPI planning process and manage supply chain fiscal strategy to meet revenue and cost targets. You will lead a team that owns product lifecycle support and new product introduction, financial accountability, and strategic initiatives aimed at improving operational processes.
The ideal candidate for this role has a proven track record of managing product lifecycles, can translate operational complexities to cross-functional stakeholders, and is a strategic problem solver/influencer at all levels of the organization. You see the big picture and look holistically at how each piece fits into a larger customer lifecycle experience, understanding the financial impacts of decisions from a gross margin, COGS, cash flow, and accounting perspective. You excel at partnering across the organization and have the intellectual curiosity to deeply understand Samsara’s product suite and the solution set for customers.
This is a remote position based in the United States. This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.
You should apply if:
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.
In this role, you will:
Own cross-functional communication on hardware product launch dates in conjunction with the sustaining Demand Planning  and Supply Planning team, setting plans that consider go to market factors and minimize E&O exposure.
Own the hardware cash out forecast, with real-time views and clear explanations of the business drivers leading to deltas.
Translate the corporate revenue plan into an executable product / geo / segment view for the sustaining planning team.
Communicate to leadership regarding overall NPI program health, changes in business trends, and risks & opportunities to the plan of record.
Manage average selling price (ASP) forecasts, discounting trends, and deal cycle analytics that feed into sustaining planning team, collaborating on insights and areas of opportunity.
Identify synergies and areas of opportunity to drive revenue improvement by geography and sales segmentation.
Liaise with F&S team on long term financial outlook (i.e. revenue, cash flow, warranty, and E&O), aligning on budget specifics that support company objectives and managing operations within budget guidelines.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, providing data-driven insights to support strategic decisions and gaining buy-in from key executive stakeholders (e.g. Procurement cost drivers and Product roadmaps).
Scope and own high impact projects that don’t fit neatly within one team’s scope, ensuring holistic solutions that drive top and bottom line impact.
Establish a deep understanding of Samsara’s business, products, and company priorities to assist Demand Planners and Supply Planners with insights for new programs / features, customer trends, and continuous improvement.
Assist in developing the Planning strategic roadmap, measuring and reporting progress on programs in flight and improving processes based on a comprehensive understanding of Samsara's mission and strategic goal.
Cultivate long-term relationships with key stakeholders and customers, understanding their needs and how Samsara can meet them.
Automatically included - do not run through Bias Decoder:
All Roles : Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
People Manager Roles : Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team
Minimum requirements for the role:
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant analytical field (e.g. finance / economics / mathematics / computer science / data science).
10+ years experience in forecasting, demand planning, financial planning, or similar function, with at least 3+ years directly managing teams.
Proven ability to attract and hire top talent, with a passion for coaching, mentoring, and developing others, using a humble leadership approach to drive a high-performing team.
Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to quickly synthesize information in a digestible format for a wide variety of stakeholders, including senior leadership, across different media.
Excellent team player who values other views and can earn stakeholder confidence quickly, exerting influence to drive priorities and deliver results.
An inquisitive mindset to business challenges, looking to question assumptions and bring creativity to solve problems.
Familiarity with NPI launches and previous experience with Product and Engineering teams.
Overall understanding of levers that drive free cash flow and gross margin.
An ideal candidate also has:
MBA or other Master’s degree.
Passion for building a world-class customer experience (internal and external).
Prior experience using Databricks, NetSuite, Salesforce, and e2open.
Experience in high-growth, innovative and complex organizations in a startup or a public company.
Deep understanding of electronics products.
The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary $118,160 — $189,900 USD Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our  blog post here .

title: Account Executive Product, Crypto/Stablecoins
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Bridge team helps businesses build and scale stablecoin-powered financial products and global money movement through a single API. Our virtual accounts let international consumers and businesses access, store, and spend US dollars, while our payouts infrastructure helps platforms disburse funds globally.
We collaborate across product, compliance, legal, and operations as we develop Stripe Crypto’s go-to-market approach and build a durable sales culture. Our team has built financial infrastructure at Coinbase, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, and Airbnb, and we’re focused on making stablecoins a practical foundation for global payments.
What you’ll do
As an Account Executive (New Business), you’ll help grow Bridge by turning qualified demand and outbound prospecting into successful customer relationships. You’ll own the commercial journey from first conversation through launch, translating business and technical needs into practical solutions and working with internal partners to deliver strong outcomes. You’ll also use data and field insights to improve how the team sells and how Stripe Crypto scales.
Responsibilities
Close qualified inbound leads and develop outbound opportunities through networking, cold calling, and lead follow-up
Lead discovery conversations to understand prospects’ business needs and identify relevant Bridge solutions
Manage the full sales cycle, from identifying opportunities through negotiation and close, and partner with customers and internal teams to get them live
Build and maintain client relationships that support satisfaction, repeat business, and account growth
Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets while providing detailed and accurate sales forecasts
Collaborate with product, risk, operations, and other internal teams to deliver effective solutions for clients
Lead and contribute to team projects that develop and refine the sales process and help shape the Bridge and Stripe sales culture
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
3-8 years of sales experience managing the full sales cycle for new accounts at a high-growth payments, financial technology, crypto, or technology company
A track record of exceeding sales quotas, closing net-new and upsell opportunities, and managing complex pricing or commercial negotiations
Experience using data to prioritize accounts, build business cases, and track outcomes, including familiarity with customer relationship management tools, Excel, and basic SQL, or demonstrated comfort with comparable data tools and analysis
Ability to understand technical product requirements, explain solutions across multiple technology products, and work with product, risk, and operations teams to deliver customer outcomes
Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to prioritize a high-volume territory and work persistently through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment
Enterprise AEs must be in their current role for a minimum of 24 months at the time of application.
Product Sales AE’s must be in their current role for a minimum of 24 months at the time of application.
Velocity AEs must be in their current role for a minimum of 18 months at the time of application.
Preferred qualifications
Experience managing a large book of accounts or a high-velocity sales motion
In-office Expectations
This is an in-office role. Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
description:
ABOUT TYBA

Tyba is a modeling platform for energy companies developing, financing, and operating renewable energy infrastructure. Energy companies rely on technical models daily to make crucial infrastructure decisions and operate their assets.

Our mission is to make cutting-edge models accessible to cross-functional teams so that companies can build and operate more renewable energy more profitably. We are backed by leading climate and generalist VCs and work with many of the industry’s most innovative energy companies.




THE ROLE

Tyba is hiring its first product designer. Traders, asset managers, operators, and analysts use Tyba every day to bid, monitor, and report on battery storage and energy portfolios. A lot of that work still lives in spreadsheets and in our users' heads. You'll figure out what the product should be and make it great: how it's organized, how it looks, and how it shows what our optimizer is doing for customers.

It's a rich design problem: dense, time-sensitive data for expert users making high-stakes decisions. The goal is a tool that's powerful without feeling complicated, where every detail is considered.

We're looking for a senior/staff generalist who sets direction, not just executes it. You'll break down ambiguous problems, decide what's worth solving, and carry the work from first sketch to shipped, with the taste to make it look and feel right. You'll report to the CTO, work as a peer to product and engineering, and lay the foundation for design at Tyba.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead design on our biggest problems. Partner with product and engineering to understand how users work, explore a range of directions, and carry the design from first sketch to shipped.

 - Define how Tyba looks and feels. Build the first design system. Set the visual language and core patterns the product is built on, and work with engineering so they're easy to build consistently. Partner with marketing so product and brand feel like one company.

 - Make dense data easy to act on. Design charts, tables, and workflows that let expert users read complex, time-sensitive information at a glance and act on it with confidence.

 - Get close to users. Spend time with the traders, operators, and analysts who use Tyba, build a real model of how they work, and bring that into every decision.

 - Move at startup pace. Prototype with real data, in code where it helps, and use AI to go faster without skipping the thinking.

 - Shape how we build. Bring a design perspective to roadmap and strategy, and define how design works at Tyba.
   
   


SKILLS & EXPERIENCE





REQUIRED

 - 7+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio of shipped work on real products

 - Strong product thinking: You pick the right problem, break it down, weigh options, and can explain the tradeoffs behind what shipped

 - B2B SaaS experience making dense, complex data clear for expert users: Tables, charts, dashboards, and analytical or workflow tools that replace spreadsheets

 - High ownership: You've driven projects from scoping to ship on lean teams, without waiting on a researcher, PM, or spec

 - High visual and interaction craft: Hierarchy, type, layout, states, edge cases, density

 - Clear communicator who makes complex ideas simple and brings engineering and stakeholders along

 - Thoughtful use of AI in your process: You know when it speeds you up and when it skips the thinking


PREFERRED

 - First or early designer at a startup, or 0→1 work inside a larger company

 - Design leadership experience

 - Ships code or code prototypes

 - Experience in energy, trading, finance, or another complex domain

 - Built or evolved a design system; brand and visual identity fluency

No energy background needed. Curiosity about power markets and how our users work is what matters.




COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

 - Salary: $185-235K, depending on experience and qualifications.

 - Benefits: Parental leave, medical benefits, and unlimited PTO.

 - Equity Options: Opportunity to own a stake in the company through an employee stock option plan.
   
   


FAQ




WHAT IS THE INTERVIEW PROCESS LIKE?

Our interview process focuses on core competencies. We want to make sure that you are set up for success at a fast-growing and high-impact startup. We will first get to know each other through conversations about Tyba, your background, and what you are looking for in your next role. While the specifics vary, from there, we will focus on evaluating your skills and experience relevant to the role. Once we have determined whether you are a fit for the team, we will help you get to know the company better and speak with other team members to inform your decision. We prioritize transparency, clear communication, and ensuring that we do our best to find a mutual fit.
